objective: Create a small working Python 3.12 CRM library using only sqlite3 and standard library. No web UI or external services. Save data persistently in the SQLite database path supplied by the caller. Deliver README.md and genuine pytest tests. Public API in crm.py: class CRM(path). add_customer(name,email)->int; list_customers()->list[dict] with id,name,email. add_quote(customer_id,description,total_cents)->int; list_quotes(customer_id)->list[dict] with id,customer_id,description,total_cents. add_event(title,starts_at)->int; list_events()->list[dict] with id,title,starts_at. draft_email(customer_id,subject,body)->int; list_email_drafts(customer_id)->list[dict] with id,customer_id,subject,body. close() closes the DB. Quotes and drafts must reference a real customer; otherwise raise ValueError. Reject blank customer names and negative total_cents with ValueError. Preserve Unicode, apostrophes and exact text via parameterized SQL. Emails are drafts only: never send email or make network requests. IDs are integers. Lists contain dictionaries, empty lists when no rows. Permit dividing implementation into small crm_*.py modules imported by crm.py; no dependencies, conftest, pytest configuration, or executable startup effects. Build incrementally one small complete module per iteration, then tests and README. All functional requirements are specified; no clarification needed.
scope: Contacts, quotes, calendar records and email drafts; no sending, external services or UI.
